verdicts.reason: Both put the headline above the SOLSTICE wordmark, so the brand-first reading order is inverted, and 'Garden-fresh' crowds into the green circle at the top. Both also leave a dead gap between the body copy and a shrunken can, while the CTA is oversized next to the small product. A is slightly worse because its body copy sits jammed under the wordmark with no breathing room; B spaces that block a little more evenly.
